parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: A name which is assigned to the ApplicationData instance at the time of its creation, which distinguishes it from any other application data volumes owned by the same application.

parameters.name: Capacity
parameters.description: Storage capacity of the volume, in {{units}}.

parameters.name: Encrypted
parameters.description: Whether the data is stored on an encrypted medium.

parameters.name: Retain
parameters.description: The level of persistency of the volume. Note that if this parameter has the value {{enum|Forever}}, it is possible that there is no currently installed {{object|##.DeploymentUnit}} whose {{param|##.DeploymentUnit.{i}.UUID}} matches the {{param|ApplicationUUID}} of this {{object|#}} table entry; this situation will be resolved when either a matching {{object|##.DeploymentUnit}} is re-installed, or this volume is removed using the {{command|Remove()}} command.

parameters.name: AccessPath
parameters.description: The path by which the Execution Units created by the Deployment Unit may access the storage volume.

parameters.name: ApplicationUUID
parameters.description: The {{param|##.DeploymentUnit.{i}.UUID}} of the {{object|##.DeploymentUnit}} for which this volume was created. This parameter retains its value so long as the {{object}} instance continues to exist, even if the {{object|##.DeploymentUnit}} is not currently installed.

parameters.name: Utilization
parameters.description: The amount of data which is currently stored in this volume, in {{units}}.

object.description: The ApplicationData volumes which currently exist within this ExecEnv. The entries in this table are created automatically as a result of calls to {{command|##.InstallDU()}} and {{command|##.DeploymentUnit.{i}.Update()}}, and are removed as a result of calls to {{command|##.DeploymentUnit.{i}.Update()}}, {{command|##.DeploymentUnit.{i}.Uninstall()}}, and {{command|Remove()}}.
